definitions.explanation: A structure built around a property for privacy or security, typically made of concrete, wood, or bamboo.

examples.japanese: {高|たか}い{塀|へい}に{囲|かこ}まれた{家|いえ}。
examples.english: A house surrounded by a tall wall.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{塀|へい}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: The child climbed over the fence.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}との{境|さかい}に{塀|へい}を{建|た}てた。
examples.english: We built a fence on the boundary with our neighbor.

notes:
USAGE: {塀|へい} refers specifically to walls/fences around properties, not interior walls or national borders.

TYPES:
・{板塀|いたべい} (wooden fence)
・{ブロック塀|ブロックべい} (concrete block wall)
・{石塀|いしべい} (stone wall)
・{竹垣|たけがき} (bamboo fence)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{塀|へい}を{建|た}てる (to build a fence)
・{塀|へい}を{越|こ}える (to climb over a fence)
・{塀|へい}に{囲|かこ}まれる (to be surrounded by a wall)

RELATED:
・{壁|かべ} - wall (interior/building wall)
・{柵|さく} - fence (simpler barrier)
